prompt:
Use your built-in image_gen tool to make exactly 1 separate image from this spec. Follow the spec literally, do not add text, logos or watermarks unless the spec asks. SPEC:
Game HUD UI element for an East Asian fantasy action RPG (Yuruma). Ornamental frame of black lacquer and engraved dark bronze with thin gold inlay, subtle cloud and dragon-scale motifs, small red lacquer accents, worn edges. Orthographic flat front view, perfectly symmetric where sensible, crisp clean silhouette, no perspective, no characters, no text, no numbers, no letters. Empty dark inner channels where bars or icons will go. Isolated on a transparent background (or a flat pure #00FF00 chroma green background if transparency is unavailable).
A square skill-slot frame for an action-bar ability icon, matching the ornament language of Image 1 (crimson and antique gold, baroque roses), empty dark inner square for the icon.
Input images: Image 1: reference for style, shapes and composition.
Aspect: square 1:1.
Background: genuinely transparent (alpha), no backdrop, no shadow plate.
